permissionManifestAssessment.reason: A7.1 calls the exact digest-bound oracle steer-permissions-manifest/v1 while the file declares steer-permissions-manifest/v2. The same normative binding cannot require both schema identities.

retentionDeterminismAssessment.reason: The referenced-technical-evidence row makes deletion-due conditional on every Git reference already having a retained signed tombstone and verification material. For an unheld, conflict-free record at or after expiry when that condition is false, the external-state table supplies no state: retained-immutable applies only before expiry, while quarantined-deletion-pending presumes the deletion transition.

humanRulingTimingAssessment.humanBlocker: A qualified privacy/legal records owner must sign a durable HR-01 decision over the exact corrected retention-policy digest and bound Exam revision. The current digest is not ready because R3-002 remains. HR-02 is not a current commercial blocker.

newFindings.summary: The Exam amendment names the permissions oracle as schema v1 while its exact digest-bound manifest declares schema v2.
newFindings.impact: An implementation or validator cannot satisfy one normative binding that simultaneously identifies the same bytes as two different schema versions; exact set comparison remains non-portable until the identifier is singular.
newFindings.requiredResolution: Change the A7.1 schema identifier to steer-permissions-manifest/v2, retain the exact current or recomputed digest, and refresh every affected amendment, manifest, resolution, and review hash.

newFindings.summary: The retention policy still lacks one external state for referenced evidence at or after expiry when its tombstone prerequisite is not met.
newFindings.impact: Two conforming implementations can retain the object under an unnamed post-expiry state or enter quarantine despite the unmet deletion-due condition, so the boundary oracle is not singular and HR-01 cannot safely bind this digest.
newFindings.requiredResolution: Define the one externally assertable state and transition for unheld referenced evidence whose signed-tombstone and verification-material prerequisite is false at or after expiry; add exact boundary rows for prerequisite true, false, missing, and ambiguous; then refresh every affected digest before HR-01.

overall.rationale: The packet is byte-integrity clean, non-circular, and preserves every prior finding ID. R2-001 and R2-004 are resolved, signed-log vectors reproduce, and commercial versus regulated ruling timing is correct. Hold remains because R2-002 and R2-003 are not fully deterministic: A7.1 has a v1/v2 schema contradiction and the retention policy has an at/after-expiry state gap. After those technical corrections and refreshed hashes, HR-01 is the sole currently triggered human ruling; HR-02 remains correctly deferred and default-closed for future regulated use.
